message.content:
Here are the best sources for free 3D game assets in 2026, organized by category:

## Top Free 3D Model Libraries

**Kenney.nl** — Over 40,000 CC0 assets with a consistent low-poly style. Includes 2D sprites, 3D models, UI elements, fonts, and audio. No attribution required; perfect for rapid prototyping and game jams.

**Quaternius** — Thousands of CC0 low-poly 3D models including characters, animals, vehicles, environments, and weapons. Assets come rigged and animated, ready for Unity, Unreal, or Godot.

**Poly Haven** — CC0 library of realistic 3D models, PBR textures, and HDRIs. No sign-up required. Best for environment art and realistic lighting setups.

**Sketchfab** — Over 500,000 free models with an interactive 3D preview before download. Licenses vary (many CC0 or CC-BY), so check each asset individually.

**Meshy.ai** — AI-generated 3D models with 6,870+ free downloads in STL, GLB, FBX, and OBJ formats. All models are CC0 and include PBR textures. Compatible with Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine, and Maya.

**PolyScann** — CC0 3D models optimized for Unity with game-ready topology and PBR textures. Compatible with Built-in, URP, and HDRP render pipelines.

## Free Textures & Materials

**ambientCG** — Over 2,000 PBR materials and HDRIs, all CC0. Includes albedo, normal, roughness, metallic, height, and ambient occlusion maps. Resolutions up to 8K.

**CGBookcase** — Smaller but high-quality CC0 texture library with tutorials on PBR texture creation.

**FreeStylized** — 150+ stylized 4K textures and game-ready asset packs with LODs for Unity, Unreal, and Godot.

## Free Characters & Animations

**Mixamo** — Adobe's free library of rigged characters and motion-captured animations. Free for commercial use with no attribution required. Includes auto-rigging for custom characters.

## Complete Asset Collections & Marketplaces

**itch.io (Free Section)** — Huge variety of free and "pay what you want" asset packs. Filter by engine (Unity, Godot, Unreal) and art style. Licenses vary by creator.

**OpenGameArt.org** — Community-driven library with 2D/3D assets, music, and sound effects under open licenses (CC0, CC-BY, GPL). Best for finding unique and retro-style content.

**Unity Asset Store (Free Section)** — Large free catalogue from professional publishers, including demo assets and starter kits.

**Unreal Engine Marketplace (Free)** — Free characters, environments, blueprints, VFX, and sample projects for Unreal developers.

## Key Tips for Using Free Assets

| Consideration | Recommendation |
|-------------|---------------|
| **License** | Always verify—CC0 requires no attribution; CC-BY requires credit |
| **Style consistency** | Stick to 1-2 visual styles per project |
| **File formats** | GLB/glTF for web games (all-in-one); FBX for Unity/Unreal |
| **Polygon budget** | Mobile: 5K-20K; Web: 10K-50K; PC/Console: 50K-300K triangles |
| **Texture resolution** | Mobile: 512-1024px; Desktop: 1024-2048px |

Sources:
1. https://www.meshy.ai/tags/game
2. https://www.seeles.ai/resources/blogs/free-3d-game-assets
3. https://assethoard.com/blog/where-to-find-free-game-assets-2026
4. https://polyscann.com/blog/post/best-free-3d-assets-for-unity-2026
5. https://gamineai.com/blog/top-15-free-game-development-asset-packs-2026
6. https://freestylized.com/
7. https://teachaitools.blog/blog/ai-game-art-generators-2025
